items.title: Percy Heath — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: he hooked us up with a woman in Italy, Señora Fenzi, had a classical agency... They put us on tours throughout Italy.

ctx.x: That’s right, that was the only vocal. You could have one of them sixty-four thousand dollar question about who was the one vocalist on a Modern Jazz Quartet album. Monte had also the same vision of booking us in those places that were heretofore not jazz venues, so he hooked us up with a woman in Italy, Señora Fenzi, had a classical agency.
